scope: Editorial decisions for the non-scalp batch (handoff dated 11 October 2026 and its review), published on one page about measurements beyond scalp EEG. Its own manifest: it amends no earlier review and changes no released file. Three locally executed analyses are published as aggregates: a fixed hemodynamic classifier on the Bak 2019 fNIRS dataset (30 people, leave one whole person out), a fixed ridge decoder of finger velocity from intracortical spiking on MC_RTT (one macaque, one session, the stored training and validation trials), and a label-independent numerical coverage check of the ds007420 optical recordings (counts only). Two sources are status only, prepared and not scored: FALCON H2 human intracortical handwriting and the human functional ultrasound runs of Rabut et al. The ds007420 classifier is a hold. Species, modalities, tasks and metrics are never pooled and share no ranking; nothing joins the eight-protocol matrix; every result is this site's own experiment, not a score copied from a paper. The handoff, its review, the protocols, the preparation and freeze reviews and the independent result audits are pinned by SHA-256 and checked by the export, never copied, because they carry private storage paths. The rights evidence was read by this session from each source's official record and paper and is kept under evidence/beyond-scalp/.

approval.basis: The owner's request in chat on 2026-10-12: prepare the next site version from the handoff index and the files added to the project. Relayed by the workflow with it: two topic pages, one of them for the non-scalp batch (beyond scalp EEG), each with a home card and dataset pages per the site's convention; aggregate results only; a local build for the owner's preview before anything is deployed. The batch's own independent result audits make each aggregate release-eligible; this record is the publishing review on top of them, not a replacement.
decisionsOfThisReview: MC_RTT is one macaque. The site publishes no score from a single person (the Stieger one-person pilot is status only for that reason); that rule protects people and does not carry over to a published animal dataset released under CC BY 4.0 and collected under institutional animal-care approval. The five validation metrics of the ridge and of the training-mean comparator are published, with the statement that every figure is that one animal's.

MC_RTT: all five metrics are published for both arms, including the mean absolute error on which the ridge is worse than the training mean. No interval is published: the validation rows are correlated samples from one animal and one session, and the analysis reports none.

Bak 2019: the participant-macro balanced accuracy with its descriptive participant-bootstrap interval, and the class recalls over all held-out predictions, are published for the classifier; the source prior's balanced accuracy and class recalls are published without an interval, because its interval is degenerate (it equals the mean). The pooled confusion matrices are not published.

Bak 2019 consent and ethics: the publisher's article page (mdpi.com) returned HTTP 403 Access Denied to this session's plain requests and to the fetch tool, and nothing was bypassed. The statement was read from the Internet Archive's capture of that article page dated 2023-07-31 (raw capture, pinned here; its citation_doi is the paper's DOI). This is flagged for the owner's preview. Setting this source's decision to "hold" publishes the standby hold kept below under the same id instead of its figures, without other changes.

ds007420: only whole-dataset counts of the label-independent numerical check are published; they are coverage measurements, not signal quality, neural origin, task validity or decoding evidence. The classifier is a hold.

FALCON H2 and Rabut fUS are status only: the preparation counts the handoff states are published (trials, files, symbols; runs and frames), and no score exists for either. Each has one human participant: a score from either would be that one person's, and publishing one would need its own decision.

The species and the modality are named on every entry. Human fNIRS, macaque intracortical spiking, human intracortical spiking and human functional ultrasound are separate measured quantities and are never ranked against each other or against scalp EEG.

notPublished: Per-person, per-recording, per-channel, per-trial, per-fold and per-row values of any kind; the confusion matrices of the Bak classifier and comparator; participant, recording, file and session identifiers; recording dates.
Signals, features, predictions, model coefficients, normalization statistics, cue texts, label arrays, timestamps and images.
Measured compute and storage: stage runtimes, the acquisition totals and the free-space observations of the handoff. They are server measurements, not model throughput.

The handoff, its review, the protocols, the preparation and freeze reviews, the result audits and the readiness notes themselves: each is pinned by SHA-256 in this manifest and its pass or binding is checked by the export. They carry private storage paths and server names and are not copied.
Demographic tables from the original publications: ages, sex, handedness, diagnosis and the like.
Any score for FALCON H2, Rabut fUS or a ds007420 classifier: none exists. The batch's other candidate sources and the model strategy and next experiments of the handoff are not published.
